label: Every admissible profile is exclusion-free
paraphrase: Difference statement of member-grounded admissibility over its sufficiency direction (#1598), OPEN, not asserted: every admissible intrinsic profile is exclusion-free, so no member of an admissible profile requires the lack of some of its members. It is the necessity direction of member grounding, the part that makes every member's requirement of a lack binding: a profile containing one is inadmissible.
